name: Bolinhos de Coco
author: Mealwhiles on based.cooking
steps: Mix the non-optional ingredients in a medium bowl.
Scoop tablespoons of the batter into a cookie sheet or cupcake pan.
Cook for around 10 minutes or until slightly brown on top.
Top with powdered sugar if desired.

culture.text: This is a Portuguese dish that translates to "coconut cupcakes," though there are probably lots of equivalent dishes from other cultures. Its simplicity and short preparation time make it perfect for a snack or dessert.
